source_atom_set_digest_rule: 全source JSONLのUTF-8 serialized line bytesをそのままSHA-256。各subsetのMPR digestはatom_id ascendingで `atom_id SP source_line_sha256 without sha256: LF` をSHA-256。Assertion/context refsはsource atoms外.
